description: On the tabletop ahead there’s a clear plastic tray near the back center, a small blue rectangular box in front of it, a multicolored cube to the right, and a gray bone-shaped item near the front. The left hand stays resting on the left side while the right hand reaches forward to the blue box, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts it up and slightly left, then lowers and releases it into the clear plastic tray, leaving the right hand empty again.
